name: Almond Flour Pancakes
instructions: Batter: Whisk eggs, milk, and vanilla. Stir in almond flour, baking powder, and cinnamon until smooth.
Pan: Heat coconut oil in a non-stick pan over LOW heat (almond flour burns easily).
Cook: Pour small circles of batter. Cover pan with a lid to help set the center. Cook 3-4 mins until bubbles appear.
Flip: Carefully flip and cook 2 mins on other side. Serve with berries.

name: Avocado Cucumber Salad
instructions: Prep: Dice avocados and cucumber into uniform chunks. Slice cherry tomatoes in half.
Dressing: In a small bowl, whisk olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Combine: Gently toss vegetables in a large bowl. Add chopped cilantro.
Finish: Pour dressing over salad right before serving to keep avocado fresh. Toss gently.

name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
instructions: Toast: Toast the sourdough until golden and crisp.
Mash: In a bowl, mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Spread thickly onto toast.
Poach: Bring water to a gentle simmer with a splash of vinegar. Whirl water to create a vortex. Drop egg in. Cook 3 mins.
Assemble: Lift egg with slotted spoon. Drain. Place on toast. Top with chili flakes.

name: Bacon and Eggs
instructions: Bacon: Place bacon in a cold pan. Turn heat to medium. Cook 8-10 mins, flipping occasionally, until crispy. Remove to paper towel.
Eggs: Drain most fat (leave 1 tbsp). Crack eggs into the pan. Fry for 3 mins (sunny side) or flip for over-easy.
Toast: Butter your toast while warm.
Plate: Serve eggs alongside bacon. Garnish eggs with fresh chives and pepper.

name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
instructions: Toss: Coat asparagus in oil, salt, and pepper.
Sheet Pan: Place salmon and asparagus on baking sheet. Top fish with lemon and dill.
Bake: 400°F (200°C) for 12-15 minutes until fish flakes easily.

name: Beef Stir Fry
instructions: Sear: Cook beef in hot oil for 2 mins. Remove.
Steam: Add broccoli and a splash of water to pan. Cover for 2 mins.
Combine: Add beef back with soy sauce and aromatics. Toss to coat.

name: Beef Tacos
instructions: Beef: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat. Drain fat. Stir in taco seasoning and a splash of water. Simmer 2 mins.
Tortillas: Warm tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side until pliable.
Assemble: Fill tortillas with beef. Top with salsa, avocado slices, and cilantro.
Serve: Squeeze fresh lime juice over tacos before eating.

name: Berry Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend: Combine frozen berries, frozen banana, and a *small* amount of milk in a blender.
Pulse: Pulse or blend on low, scraping down sides often.
Texture: Use the tamper if you have one. Goal is thick soft-serve texture, not drinkable liquid.
Serve: Scoop into a bowl immediately. Arrange toppings artistically.

name: Blueberry Pancakes
instructions: Batter: Whisk flour, sugar, and baking powder. In a separate bowl, mix milk, egg, and melted butter.
Combine: Stir wet into dry ingredients until just mixed (lumps are okay!). Gently fold in blueberries.
Cook: Heat a buttered griddle or pan. Pour 1/4 cup batter. Flip when bubbles form on surface (approx 2-3 mins).
Serve: Stack high and serve with warm maple syrup.

name: Breakfast Quinoa Bowl
instructions: Warm: Stir warm milk into cooked quinoa.
Flavor: Mix in maple syrup and cinnamon.
Top: Add nuts or seeds. Eat warm like oatmeal.

name: Caprese Salad
instructions: Assemble: Alternate slices of tomato and mozzarella on a plate.
Garnish: Tuck basil leaves between layers.
Finish: Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic. Sprinkle sea salt.

name: Cauliflower Rice Stir Fry
instructions: Tofu: Pan-fry tofu cubes in a little oil until golden brown on all sides. Remove from pan.
Veggies: Add sesame oil to pan. Sauté snap peas for 2 mins.
Rice: Add cauliflower rice. Stir fry for 3-4 mins until tender but not mushy.
Combine: Return tofu to pan. Drizzle soy sauce (and sriracha). Toss to coat.

name: Chia Seed Pudding
instructions: Mix: In a mason jar or bowl, whisk chia seeds, milk, vanilla, and syrup vigorously to prevent clumping.
Set: Let sit for 5 mins, then whisk again. (Crucial step!).
Chill: Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours (or overnight) until thick and pudding-like.
Serve: Top with fresh berries before eating.

name: Chicken Alfredo Pasta
instructions: Pasta: Boil salted water. Cook fettuccine al dente (approx 10-12 mins). Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Chicken: Season breast with salt. Pan-sear in butter for 6 mins per side until golden. Slice.
Sauce: In the same pan, sauté minced garlic. Pour in heavy cream and simmer for 5 mins until slightly reduced.
Combine: Whisk in parmesan until melted. Toss pasta and chicken in the sauce. Add pasta water if too thick.
Serve: Garnish with fresh parsley.

name: Chicken Curry
instructions: Fry: Cook curry paste in oil for 1 min until fragrant.
Meat: Add chicken. Stir fry to coat.
Simmer: Add coconut milk and veggies. Simmer 15 mins until chicken is cooked.

name: Chicken Wrap
instructions: Layer: Lay tortilla flat. Add sauce, then lettuce (to prevent sogginess).
Fill: Add chicken and tomatoes.
Roll: Fold sides in and roll tightly. Slice on diagonal.

name: Cobb Salad
instructions: Base: Place lettuce in a large bowl.
Arrange: Place toppings in rows (chicken, egg, bacon, avocado, cheese).
Serve: Drizzle with ranch or vinaigrette.

name: Coconut Curry Lentils
instructions: Sauté: Cook onion in a splash of oil until soft (5 mins). Add garlic, curry powder, and turmeric. Toast spices for 1 min.
Simmer: Add dry lentils, vegetable broth, and coconut milk. Stir well.
Cook: Cover and simmer on low for 15-20 minutes until lentils are soft and creamy.
Finish: Stir in fresh spinach until wilted. Season with salt and a squeeze of lime.

name: Egg Roll in a Bowl
instructions: Pork: Brown ground pork in a skillet. Break into small crumbles. Drain half the fat.
Aromatics: Add ginger and garlic. Cook for 1 min until fragrant.
Veggies: Dump in the coleslaw mix. Pour soy sauce over. Stir fry for 3-4 mins until cabbage is wilted but still slightly crunchy.
Finish: Drizzle with sesame oil and top with green onions.

name: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Bread: Dip eggplant slices in egg, then breadcrumbs.
Bake: Roast slices at 400°F (200°C) for 20 mins.
Layer: Top roast slices with sauce and cheese. Bake 10 more mins.

name: Falafel Pita
instructions: Warm: Heat pita slightly to prevent tearing.
Fill: Spread hummus inside. Stuff with falafel and veggies.
Drizzle: Top with runny tahini sauce.

name: Fish Tacos
instructions: Season: Coat fish in taco seasoning/cumin.
Pan-Fry: Cook in skillet for 3 mins/side until flaky.
Assemble: Warm tortillas. Fill with fish, slaw, and crema.

name: Greek Yogurt Bowl
instructions: Assemble: Bowl of yogurt.
Top: Add honey and nuts.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Base: Spoon half the yogurt into a glass or bowl.
Layer: Add a layer of granola and half the berries.
Repeat: Top with remaining yogurt, granola, and berries.
Finish: Drizzle generously with honey and sprinkle with chia seeds.

name: Greek Yogurt with Honey
instructions: Scoop: Place thick Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Drizzle: Pour honey over the yogurt generously.
Crunch: Top with chopped walnuts and a dusting of cinnamon for warmth.

name: Grilled Chicken Caesar
instructions: Grill: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Grill or pan-sear for 6-8 mins per side until fully cooked (165°F). Let rest.
Base: In a large bowl, toss chopped romaine with caesar dressing until evenly coated.
Assemble: Slice chicken into strips. Arrange over salad.
Garnish: Top generously with parmesan shavings, croutons, and a squeeze of fresh lemon.

name: Grilled Shrimp Skewers
instructions: Marinate: Toss shrimp with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, oatregno, salt, and pepper. Let sit for 15 mins.
Assemble: Thread shrimp, peppers, and onion chunks alternating onto skewers.
Cook: Grill or pan-sear on high heat for 2-3 mins per side until shrimp are opaque and pink. Do not overcook.
Serve: Garnish with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.

name: Hearty Vegetable Soup
instructions: Sauté: Cook aromatics in pot.
Simmer: Add broth, beans, and herbs. Cook 20 mins until veggies are tender.
Season: Salt and pepper to taste.

name: Lemon Herb Chicken
instructions: Season: Rub chicken with spices and butter.
Roast: Place in baking dish with lemon slices. Roast at 400°F (200°C) for 35-40 mins.
Rest: Let rest 5 mins before serving.

name: Lentil Salad
instructions: Combine: Mix lentils, cucumber, pepper, and parsley in a bowl.
Dress: Toss with vinaigrette.
Rest: Let sit 10 mins for flavors to meld.

name: Lentil Soup
instructions: Sauté: Heat oil in a heavy pot. Cook onion, carrots, and celery for 5-7 mins until soft. Add garlic and thyme for 1 min.
Simmer: Add rinsed lentils and vegetable broth. Bring to boil, then reduce heat to low.
Cook: Cover and simmer for 25-30 minutes until lentils are tender but not mushy.
Texture: Use an immersion blender to pulse the soup 2-3 times (or mash some lentils) for a creamy texture.

name: Miso Glazed Cod
instructions: Marinade: Whisk miso, sake, soy sauce, maple syrup, and ginger until smooth.
Prep: Pat cod dry. Brush marinade generously over fish. Let sit for 20 mins (or up to 24 hrs for depth).
Cook: Preheat broiler. Place fish on a foil-lined sheet. Broil on high for 6-8 minutes.
Watch: Keep a close eye! The miso sugar should caramelize and char slightly, but not burn.

name: Mushroom Spinach Frittata
instructions: Sauté: Brown mushrooms in oven-safe pan. Add spinach until wilted.
Pour: Beat eggs with salt. Pour over veggies.
Bake: Top with feta. Bake at 350°F for 10-12 mins until set.

name: Oatmeal with Berries
instructions: Simmer: Bring almond milk to a gentle boil. Add oats and cinnamon. Reduce heat to low.
Cook: Simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until oats are creamy and liquid is absorbed.
Serve: Remove from heat. Stir in half the strawberries. Top with remaining berries and chia seeds.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
instructions: Toast: Toast bread until golden.
Spread: Apply a thick layer of peanut butter while toast is warm.
Top: Layer banana slices. Sprinkle with chia seeds for crunch.

name: Pesto Pasta
instructions: Boil: Cook pasta in salted water until al dente.
Reserve: Save 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
Toss: Mix pasta, pesto, and splash of water vigorously. Top with tomatoes/cheese.

name: Portobello & Swiss Burger
instructions: Grill mushrooms.
Melt cheese.
Place on bun.

name: Portobello Mushroom Burger
instructions: Marinate: Brush mushrooms with balsamic and oil.
Grill: Grill caps for 4-5 mins per side.
Assemble: Place on bun or lettuce wrap. Top with avocado.

name: Quinoa Salad
instructions: Quinoa: Rinse quinoa. Boil with 1 cup water. Simmer 15 mins. Let cool completely (spread on a plate to speed up).
Veggies: Dice cucumber, halve tomatoes, and mince onion.
Dressing: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Toss: Combine cold quinoa, veggies, and feta. Pour dressing over and toss well.

name: Salmon Salad
instructions: Salmon: Season with salt, pepper, and dill. Sear skin-side down in a hot pan for 4 mins. Flip and cook 2 more mins.
Dressing: Whisk olive oil, juice of half a lemon, salt, and pepper.
Salad: Toss greens and cucumber with half the dressing.
Plate: Top salad with warm salmon. Drizzle remaining dressing over the fish.

name: Scrambled Tofu Burrito
instructions: Scramble: Sauté crumbled tofu with turmeric, salt, and pepper for 5 mins.
Mix: Stir in black beans and salsa. Cook until heated through.
Wrap: Spoon onto tortilla. Fold sides in and roll tight. Toast in pan for crunch.

name: Shakshuka
instructions: Base: Sauté onion and bell pepper in oil until soft (5 mins). Add garlic and spices.
Simmer: Pour in tomatoes. Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 mins to thicken sauce.
Eggs: Make 4 small wells in the sauce. Gently crack an egg into each well.
Steam: Cover pan with a lid. Cook 5-7 mins until whites are set but yolks are runny. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Shrimp Taco Bowl
instructions: Sauté: Cook seasoned shrimp for 3 mins.
Warm: Heat corn and beans.
Bowl: Layer rice, beans, corn, and shrimp. Top with salsa.

name: Smoked Salmon Bagel
instructions: Toast: Slice and toast bagel halves.
Spread: Apply generous cream cheese.
Layer: Top with ribbons of smoked salmon, red onion, and capers.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Sauce: Brown beef with onion. Drain fat. Add sauce and simmer 20 mins.
Pasta: Boil spaghetti.
Serve: Ladle sauce over pasta. Top with cheese.

name: Spinach & Mushroom Omelet
instructions: Fillings: Sauté mushrooms in a small pan until browned (3-4 mins). Add spinach and cook until wilted. Remove from pan.
Eggs: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper in a bowl.
Cook: Melt butter in pan. Pour in eggs. Tilt pan to spread. Lift edges to let raw egg run underneath.
Fold: When eggs are set but slightly wet on top, sprinkle cheese and veggie mix on one half. Fold over. Cook 1 more min.

name: Spinach Pasta
instructions: Boil: Cook pasta in salted water. Reserve 1/4 cup water.
Sauté: Cook garlic in oil. Add spinach until wilted.
Toss: Add drained pasta and pasta water. Toss with parmesan.

name: Steak and Asparagus
instructions: Prep: Pat steak dry. Season liberally with salt and pepper. Snap woody ends off asparagus.
Sear: Heat olive oil in a skillet over high heat. Sear steak 3-4 mins per side for medium-rare.
Baste: Lower heat. Add butter, crushed garlic, and rosemary. Spoon foaming butter over steak for 1 min.
Rest: Remove steak and rest for 5-10 mins.
Veg: In the same pan, sauté asparagus for 4-5 mins until tender-crisp.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Prep: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut tops off peppers and remove seeds. Par-boil peppers for 3 mins if you like them softer.
Filling: Brown beef with onion. Drain fat. Mix in cooked rice, half the tomato sauce, and Italian seasoning.
Stuff: Spoon mixture into peppers. Stand peppers upright in a baking dish.
Bake: Pour remaining sauce around peppers. Cover with foil. Bake 30 mins. Uncover, top with cheese, bake 5 mins.

name: Tofu Scramble
instructions: Prep: Drain and press tofu to remove water. Crumble into bite-sized chunks.
Sauté: Heat oil in a non-stick pan. Sauté diced onion for 3-4 mins until translucent.
Scramble: Add tofu, turmeric, nutritional yeast, and black salt. Cook for 5-7 mins until yellow and firm.
Finish: Fold in spinach and cook until just wilted. Serve hot.

name: Tuna Salad
instructions: Mix: Flake tuna in a bowl.
Combine: Add mayo, celery, relish, and mustard. Mix well.
Serve: Eat with crackers or on greens.

name: Turkey Burger
instructions: Cook: Grill or pan-fry patty for 4-5 mins per side (ensure fully cooked).
Assembl: Toast bun. Stack lettuce, tomato, patty, and mustard.

name: Turkey Sandwich
instructions: Toast: Lightly toast the bread slices.
Spread: Apply mayo or mustard to one or both slices.
Layer: Place lettuce first (keeps bread dry), then turkey folded for volume, cheese, tomato, and cucumber.
Serve: Close sandwich. Slice diagonally. Season tomato with a pinch of salt if desired.

name: Vegan Buddha Bowl
instructions: Prep: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss chickpeas and sweet potato cubes with olive oil, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Roast: Bake for 20-25 minutes until chickpeas are crispy and potatoes are tender.
Grains: Rinse quinoa. Simmer in 1 cup water for 15 mins. Fluff with a fork.
Sauce: Whisk tahini with lemon juice and a splash of warm water until creamy.
Assemble: Arrange quinoa, roast veg, and sliced avocado in a bowl. Drizzle with sauce.

name: Vegan Pancakes
instructions: Batter: Whisk dry ingredients. Slowly add milk, oil, and vanilla. Whisk until smooth.
Rest: Let batter sit for 5 mins to activate baking powder.
Cook: Pour onto hot oiled griddle. Flip when bubbles pop. Cook until golden brown.

name: Vegetable Omelette
instructions: Prep: Beat eggs in a bowl with a fork until yolk and white are fully combined. Season with salt.
Sauté: Heat butter in non-stick pan. Cook peppers and onion for 2 mins.
Cook: Pour in eggs. Let sit for 30s. Pull cooked edges toward center, letting liquid flow out.
Fold: When surface is almost dry, add cheese and spinach. Fold in half. Slide onto plate.

name: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Sauté: Cook aromatics in pot.
Simmer: Add broth and herbs. Cook 20 mins until veggies are tender.
Season: Salt and pepper to taste.

name: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Prep: Cook rice according to package. Chop all vegetables into uniform bite-sized pieces.
Sauce: Whisk soy sauce, minced ginger, garlic, sesame oil, and a splash of water.
Stir Fry: Heat oil in a wok/pan over high heat. Toss in veggies. Stir fry for 5-7 mins until tender-crisp.
Combine: Pour sauce over veggies. Cook for 1 min until sauce bubbles and coats everything. Serve over rice.

name: Vegetarian Chili
instructions: Sauté: Cook onion and pepper in a large pot until soft.
Spices: Add chili powder and cumin. Stir for 1 min.
Simmer: Add tomatoes and beans. Simmer for 30 mins. Serve hot.

name: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto
instructions: Noodles: Spiralize zucchini into noodles. (Or use a peeler for ribbons).
Cook: Heat oil in a large pan. Sauté zoodles for just 2-3 minutes. Do not overcook or they will get watery.
Sauce: Remove from heat immediately. Toss with pesto.
Serve: Fold in cherry tomatoes. Top with pine nuts and parmesan.

name: Classic Shakshuka
instructions: Sauté: Heat oil in a large skillet. Add onion and bell pepper. Cook until soft (approx 5 mins).
Aromatics: Add garlic, cumin, and paprika. Cook for 1 min until fragrant.
Simmer: Pour in tomatoes. Simmer for 10 mins until sauce thickens. Season with salt/pepper.
Poach: Use a spoon to make 3 wells in the sauce. Crack an egg into each well.
Finish: Cover and cook for 5-8 mins until egg whites are set but yolks are still runny. Top with feta and parsley.

name: Miso Glazed Salmon
instructions: Glaze: Whisk miso, mirin, sake, sugar, and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Marinate: Coat salmon with the glaze and let sit for 15-20 mins.
Broil: Preheat broiler. Place salmon skin-side down on a foil-lined tray.
Cook: Broil 6-8 inches from heat for 8-10 mins until charred and flaky.
Steam: Briefly steam/sauté bok choy and serve alongside salmon.

name: Palak Paneer
instructions: Blanch: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 2 mins, then plunge into cold water. Blend into a smooth puree.
Fry: Briefly brown paneer cubes in a pan with a little oil. Set aside.
Base: Sauté onion until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes. Cook until soft.
Simmer: Add spinach puree, garam masala, and salt. Simmer for 5 mins.
Finish: Fold in paneer and cream. Serve hot with naan or rice.

name: Thai Green Curry with Tofu
instructions: Paste: Fry curry paste in a pot with 2 tbsp coconut milk until fragrant.
Liquid: Add remaining coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Veg: Add tofu, bamboo shoots, and green beans. Simmer for 8-10 mins until tender.
Season: Stir in soy sauce and a pinch of sugar.
Finish: Remove from heat and fold in Thai basil. Serve over jasmine rice.

name: Greek Lamb Chops
instructions: Marinade: Rub lamb with oil, oregano, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper. Let sit for 30 mins.
Grill: Sear chops on a hot grill or skillet for 3-4 mins per side for medium-rare.
Rest: Let meat rest for 5 mins.
Serve: Serve with a side of tzatziki and a Greek salad.

name: Mexican Burrito Bowl
instructions: Meat: Brown meat with taco seasoning. Drain fat.
Base: Add rice to a large bowl.
Assemble: Top with meat, beans, corn, and sliced avocado.
Finish: Garnish with salsa and a dollop of Greek yogurt.

name: Moroccan Chickpea Tagine
instructions: Sauté: Cook onion and carrots in a deep pan until soft.
Spices: Stir in chickpeas, apricots, cinnamon, and coriander.
Simmer: Pour in broth. Cover and simmer for 15 mins until veggies are tender.
Serve: Serve over a bed of fluffy couscous.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Sear: Heat oil in a pan. Add shrimp and cook 2 mins per side until pink. Set aside.
Aromatics: Add more oil if needed. Sauté garlic, lemon zest, and red pepper flakes for 1 min.
Veg: Toss in zucchini noodles and cook for 2-3 mins until tender-crisp.
Combine: Return shrimp to pan, toss with lemon juice and parsley. Serve immediately.

name: Peanut satay Tofu Bowl
instructions: Bake: Slice tofu into slabs. Bake at 400°F for 20 mins until firm.
Sauce: Whisk peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, and a splash of water.
Assemble: Place quinoa in a bowl. Top with baked tofu and cucumber.
Finish: Drizzle generously with the peanut satay sauce.

name: Ratatouille
instructions: Base: Spread tomato puree, garlic, and herbs on the bottom of a baking dish.
Layer: Alternate slices of eggplant, zucchini, and squash in a spiral pattern.
Roast: Brush with olive oil. Bake at 375°F for 40-50 mins until tender.
Serve: Serve hot as a main or side dish.

name: Overnight Berry Chia Oats
instructions: Mix: In a jar, combine oats, almond milk, chia seeds, and maple syrup.
Stir: Shake or stir well until chia seeds are evenly distributed.
Chill: Refrigerate overnight or for at least 4 hours.
Serve: Top with fresh berries before eating.

name: Shakshuka with Smoked Salmon
instructions: Sauté: Briefly wilt spinach in a pan with a drop of oil.
Eggs: Scramble eggs softly in the same pan.
Fold: Gently fold in pieces of smoked salmon at the very end (don't overcook the salmon).
Serve: Dollop with Greek yogurt and serve on toast.

name: Quinoa Tabouli Salad
instructions: Prep: Ensure quinoa is cooled to room temperature.
Mix: Combine quinoa, parsley, mint, cucumber, and tomato in a large bowl.
Dress: Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Pour over salad.
Marinate: Let sit for at least 20 mins for flavors to meld.

name: Lentil Bolognese
instructions: Sauté: Cook onion and mushrooms until golden.
Sauce: Add lentils and marinara sauce. Simmer for 10 mins.
Pasta: Boil spaghetti until al dente.
Combine: Toss pasta with the lentil sauce and serve with nutritional yeast.

name: Chicken Tikka Skewers
instructions: Marinate: Mix yogurt and tikka paste. Coat chicken and let sit for 30 mins.
Skewers: Alternate chicken, pepper, and onion on skewers.
Grill: Grill or broil for 10-12 mins, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through.
Serve: Serve with a side of lemon rice or salad.

name: Mackerel and Potato Salad
instructions: Steam: Briefly steam green beans until tender-crisp.
Flake: Drain mackerel and flake into large chunks.
Combine: Toss potatoes, beans, onion, and mackerel in a bowl.
Dress: Mix mustard with a little olive oil and lemon juice. Drizzle over salad.

name: Roasted Cauliflower Steaks
instructions: Cut: Slice cauliflower into 1-inch thick 'steaks' through the core.
Season: Brush with oil and spices.
Roast: Bake at 400°F for 25-30 mins, flipping once, until edges are charred.
Finish: Drizzle with tahini sauce before serving.

name: Turkey and Apple Wrap
instructions: Spread: Apply mustard to the tortilla surface.
Layer: Place arugula, turkey slices, and apple slices in the center.
Roll: Fold ends and roll tightly.
Serve: Slice diagonally and enjoy.

name: Miso Ramen with Egg
instructions: Broth: Heat broth. Whisk in miso paste (don't boil once miso is added).
Noodles: Cook noodles separately and drain.
Assemble: Place noodles in a bowl. Pour hot broth over them.
Finish: Top with halved boiled egg, corn, and green onions.

name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Tacos
instructions: Roast: Toss sweet potato with oil and cumin. Roast at 400°F for 20 mins.
Beans: Heat beans with a splash of lime juice.
Assemble: Fill tortillas with roasted potato and beans.
Finish: Top with cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

name: Classic Poke Bowl
instructions: Prep: Toss tuna with soy sauce and green onions.
Base: Add rice to the bowl.
Assemble: Top with edamame, seaweed salad, and the marinated tuna.
Serve: Drizzle with spicy mayo if desired.

name: Green Detox Smoothie
instructions: Blend: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Smooth: Blend on high until creamy and green.
Serve: Pour into a glass and drink immediately.

name: Lentil Shepherd's Pie
instructions: Simmer: Cook lentils in broth with tomato paste until soft.
Veg: Mix in peas and carrots.
Layer: Place lentil mix in a baking dish. Top with mashed potatoes.
Bake: Bake at 400°F for 20 mins until potatoes are golden.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Fill: Roll chicken and a spoon of beans into each tortilla.
Tray: Place rolls in a baking dish. Pour sauce over them.
Cheese: Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake: Bake at 375°F for 25 mins until bubbling.

name: Mediterranean Orzo Salad
instructions: Mix: Toss all ingredients in a large bowl.
Dress: Drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, and dried oregano.
Serve: Enjoy cold as a refreshing lunch.

name: Kung Pao Tofu
instructions: Crisp: Pan-fry tofu until golden on all edges.
Sauté: Add zucchini, peanuts, and chilies to the pan.
Sauce: Pour in soy sauce mixed with a little cornstarch and water.
Toss: Cook until sauce thickens and coats the tofu.

name: BBQ Chicken Salad
instructions: Chicken: Toss grilled chicken with BBQ sauce.
Base: Place corn and beans over mixed greens.
Finish: Top with chicken and drizzle with ranch.

name: Spinach & Ricotta Stuffed Shells
instructions: Fill: Mix ricotta and spinach. Stuff into cooked shells.
Tray: Place shells in a dish over a layer of marinara.
Top: Pour remaining sauce and sprinkle cheese over shells.
Bake: Bake at 375°F for 20 mins until cheese is bubbly.

name: Cauliflower Alfredo Pasta
instructions: Sauce: Boil cauliflower and garlic until soft. Blend with milk and nutritional yeast until smooth.
Pasta: Cook pasta al dente.
Combine: Toss pasta with the cauliflower alfredo sauce. Garnish with pepper.

name: Moroccan Lamb Stew
instructions: Sear: Brown lamb in a pot. Add carrots and spices.
Simmer: Pour in broth and add prunes. Cover and simmer for 45-60 mins until lamb is tender.
Serve: Garnish with fresh mint and serve with couscous.

name: Protein French Toast
instructions: Mix: Whisk egg whites, protein powder, and cinnamon.
Soak: Soak bread slices in the mixture until absorbed.
Grill: Cook on a non-stick pan for 3 mins per side.
Serve: Top with fresh berries.

name: Niçoise Salad
instructions: Arrange: Place all ingredients separately in a bowl or on a plate.
Dress: Drizzle with a vinaigrette of olive oil, lemon, and dijon mustard.
Serve: Classic French lunch vibes.

name: Bibimbap (Bulgogi Beef)
instructions: Meat: Sauté beef with a little soy sauce and sugar.
Base: Add rice to a bowl.
Arrange: Top with individual mounds of spinach, carrots, sprouts, and beef.
Finish: Place fried egg in the center and add gochujang. Mix everything before eating.

name: Caprese Avocado Wrap
instructions: Layer: Place mozzarella, tomato, and avocado in the wrap.
Drizzle: Season with salt/pepper and balsamic glaze.
Roll: Fold and roll tightly.
Serve: Perfect for a light, fresh lunch.

name: Breakfast Quesadilla
instructions: Assemble: Place eggs, cheese, and beans on half a tortilla.
Fold: Fold over and press.
Grill: Cook on a pan for 2 mins per side until cheese is melted.
Serve: Serve with salsa.

name: Roasted Mediterranean Cod
instructions: Tray: Place cod in a baking dish. Surround with tomatoes, olives, and capers.
Season: Drizzle with olive oil and top with lemon slices.
Bake: Bake at 400°F for 12-15 mins until cod is flaky.

name: Zucchini Lasagna
instructions: Prep: Salt zucchini slices and pat dry (to avoid watery lasagna).
Meat: Brown turkey and mix with marinara.
Layer: Layer zucchini, ricotta, and meat sauce in a small dish.
Bake: Top with mozzarella and bake at 375°F for 30 mins.

name: Mushroom Risotto (Healthy)
instructions: Sauté: Cook onion and mushrooms until golden.
Rice: Add rice and stir for 1 min.
Simmer: Add hot broth 1/2 cup at a time, stirring constantly until absorbed.
Finish: Once rice is creamy, stir in parmesan and a bit of butter.

name: Pumpkin Spice Protein Oatmeal
instructions: Cook: Cook oats with water/milk until creamy.
Stir: Stir in pumpkin puree, spice, and protein powder.
Finish: Top with chopped walnuts and a splash of milk.

name: Beef Ginger Stir-fry
instructions: Sear: Sear beef on high heat until browned. Add ginger.
Veg: Add broccoli and a splash of water. Steam-fry for 3 mins.
Sauce: Add soy sauce and toss until everything is coated.
Finish: Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with rice.
